provenance: Invented bilingual operational-policy fixtures authored for tenant-rag v0.4; no customer data, external corpus, or real-model outputs. This dataset is public development material, not a statistically independent held-out benchmark.
label_policy: Each query has manually authored expected IDs and a label_rationale. Relevant means the document directly answers at least one requested part. Plausible adjacent policies remain distractors; labels have not received independent human adjudication.
